static_traits.name: Zhang Ming
static_traits.family_status: Strained relationships with family members, little communication
static_traits.social_status: A few friends to confide in, but they do not fully understand the complexity of his family relationships
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received counseling for family conflict before
static_traits.language_features: Negative attitude; often led by self-denial and emotional expressions (like 'I just feel' / 'I will mess up'); cooperative in conversation and answering guided questions; labeling, overgeneralization, personalization, mind reading, and black-and-white thinking present

basic_info.main_problem: Due to conflicts and misunderstandings, I have difficulty getting along with my family, and because of this I feel I am a failure.
basic_info.core_demands: Continued tension with family and a sense of failure markedly affect my mental health, so I seek counseling to improve the relationships and lessen the negative impact.
growth_experiences: Over the past few years, long-standing conflict and misunderstanding with family, with high interaction pressure, frequently triggering quarrels and tension; communication gradually decreased, and they often feel isolated and misunderstood at family gatherings; they tried to improve things through self-help books and online forums, but the conflict and tense relationships persist.

special_situations.event: Disagreements and misunderstandings arise at family gatherings or when discussing family matters
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot satisfy everyone and avoid conflict, it means my character is a failure and I am the root of the problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding communication, reducing interaction with family to lower the possibility of being blamed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is my fault; I will disappoint everyone.

special_situations.event: When interacting with family with rising stress, arguments escalating
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If arguments happen, it means our relationship is essentially bad, and I do not deserve understanding either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-denial, choosing silence or leaving the scene to avoid worsening the situation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We always fight like this, it will never get better.

special_situations.event: When criticized by family or relatives and friends, or when past misunderstandings are mentioned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If criticized or misunderstood, it means I am a total failure, with no value at all
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Judging himself with black-and-white standards, negating positive feedback; trying to 'fix' himself by reading self-help books and forums

special_situations.event: Discovering friends do not fully understand family dynamics when confiding in them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends do not understand either, it proves no one can help me, the problem is unsolvable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing help-seeking, choosing to bear it alone to avoid disappointment again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one understands me, things will only get worse.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted by family, and to build stable and harmonious intimate connections
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being blamed and negated, conflict escalating, feeling shame and isolation from being excluded
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being hurt and negated by keeping distance and reducing communication

object_relations.self_representation: A narrator hard to be understood
object_relations.object_representation: Friends unable to empathize, with limited understanding

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to examine evidence, identify positive behaviors, and set small-step change goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing change as a threat to the 'failure' self-label, worried advice will be futile for him, readily using rational analysis to dilute emotion
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'this is hard' and 'not realistic for me' in a calm, rational-analysis tone, reducing emotional expression, listing reasons why change is not feasible.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about family conflict or the children's future, thinking of his own limitations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Over-attributing complex external factors to his own inadequacy, turning anxiety into self-blame and guilt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeats 'it's all my problem' and 'I will mess it up' in a self-blaming tone, ignoring others' roles and available support.

manifestations: Communication minimized, often feeling isolated at family gatherings
Friends are confidable but cannot truly understand family dynamics
outcomes: Low mood and sense of failure
Declining sleep quality and physical and mental exhaustion

manifestations: Feeling efforts to improve (self-help books, forums) are also futile
Believes relationships are 'always like this' and hard to change
outcomes: Motivation and productivity decline (attention and work are affected)
Diminished hope for improving the relationship

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self; that is, the individual redirects the energy originally meant to be sent outward back toward the self, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language expressions include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it' and 'I should not trouble others'.
manifestations: In conflicts chooses silence and withdrawal; reduces communication with family
Turning dissatisfaction and hurt toward family into self-blame and guilt

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Frequent self-doubt, emphasizing his own limitations will limit others' opportunities
Repeatedly hesitates and is overly cautious before interacting with family or making decisions

exception_events.target_problem: At family events or discussions, the client usually becomes highly tense, reduces communication and falls into self-blame, leading to further estrangement and intensified conflict in relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During his daughter's homework and application process, the client actively gave encouragement and concrete help instead of sinking into self-denial; this time he took supportive action, promoting real progress and bringing some positive impact.
exception_events.reason: Clue: taking a different approach — supporting the other with concrete actions (encouragement, application help), rather than only passive reflection; relationship support — partner showing support and understanding.

positive_force: Has a degree of initiative and supportive behavior (encouraging and concretely helping family members)
Willing to try small-step changes and problem-solving training
Has a few friends to confide in, with a certain degree of social support
Has proactively sought resources (self-help books and online forums)
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions: mind reading, overgeneralization, personalization, black-and-white
Long-term tension and conflict reducing communication, feeling isolated at family gatherings
Anxiety affecting attention, work efficiency and sleep, lowering overall well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance and silence in family interactions (communication markedly reduced, feeling isolated at family gatherings)
antecedent: During family events or discussions of family matters
Rising stress in interactions, arguments escalating
target_behavior.core_reason: Under a personalization and black-and-white cognitive frame, blaming conflict on own failure, choosing avoidance and silence to avoid being negated and escalating conflict.
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome stimuli (conflict, criticism, and shame), to briefly lower anxiety and risk.
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships further distanced, tension maintained or even intensified, increased loneliness, fewer chances to improve relationships.

target_behavior.behavior: Generalized anxiety making concentration hard, decreased work efficiency, worsened sleep quality
antecedent: Thinking about tension and conflict related to family
Discussing family plans or recalling arguments
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative anticipation of relationship prospects and excessive worry (overgeneralization) maintaining hypervigilance and self-blame, forming persistent physiological and cognitive arousal.
target_behavior.function: Tries to avoid 'making mistakes' and further conflict through persistent vigilance (avoiding potential threats).
target_behavior.consequence: Declining work and daily productivity, worsening sleep quality, overall physical and mental health impaired.
